results.name: String-only conditional class-name joining
results.description: Joins nonempty primitive string arguments with spaces and ignores every non-string argument. This provides a distinct input policy from the mixed-input implementation.

results.name: Mixed-input class-name construction
results.description: Joins truthy strings and numbers, recursively processes arrays, and includes object keys whose values are truthy. Empty conversions contribute no separator.

results.name: stringify: tokens to route syntax
results.description: Serializes token data into route syntax, escaping text and quoting parameter names when required. Handles nested groups and checks following text to avoid absorbing identifier characters into names.

results.name: pathToRegexp: regex construction with capture keys
results.description: Produces a RegExp and ordered capture keys from path strings, token data or alternatives. Provides delimiter, case sensitivity, trailing delimiter and end-boundary policies, with a 256-combination limit.

results.name: match: path matching and capture decoding
results.description: Constructs a matcher returning false or a matched path plus named captures. Decodes parameters and splits decoded wildcard captures into segment arrays, with an option to disable decoding.

results.name: parse: route syntax to tokens
results.description: Parses text, named parameters, wildcards and nested brace groups into TokenData. Supports escaped characters and quoted names, with indexed errors for several malformed constructs.

results.name: compile: parameterized path generation
results.description: Builds a function that generates paths from strings or token data. Handles optional groups, encoded parameters and wildcard segment arrays, with missing-value and value-type checks.

results.name: Similarity metric benchmark harness
results.description: Ten benchmark functions exercise string similarity entry points and generic Levenshtein on byte vectors. The supplied harness can serve as a starting point for timing the evidenced algorithms.

results.name: String and sequence similarity implementations
results.description: Public entry points implement Hamming, Jaro/Jaro-Winkler, Levenshtein, OSA, unrestricted Damerau-Levenshtein and Sørensen-Dice. Generic sequence variants and normalized string scores provide distinct comparison policies within one supplied module.

results.name: Rendezvous hashing construction and lookup
results.description: New precomputes node hashes; Lookup combines a key hash with each node hash using xorshiftMult64 and selects the highest score. Empty membership returns an empty string, and tied scores retain the first node.
